content:
The City of Laredo Utilities Department is notifying the public of a sanitary sewer overflow near Mines Road and I-35, in the 8100 block of Mines Road in District 7.

The overflow is in effect until further notice. The department says heavy rainfall from natural weather conditions contributed to the overflow, and it is expected to subside once the rain stops and flow conditions return to normal.

Residents and drivers are advised to use caution in the affected area and to avoid contact with any standing or overflowing wastewater.

The Utilities Department says it will keep monitoring the situation and provide updates as conditions improve.

Source: City of Laredo Utilities Department, Facebook, November 9, 2026.

title: Sewer Overflow Reported Near Mines Road and I-35; Public Urged to Avoid Standing Wastewater
